headline: A 2018 law renames the Landmark for Peace Memorial in Indianapolis as the Kennedy-King National Commemorative Site.
what_it_does: The law changes the official name of the Landmark for Peace Memorial in Martin Luther King, Jr. Park in Indianapolis, Indiana, to the Kennedy-King National Commemorative Site. The site becomes part of the African-American Civil Rights Network. The Department of the Interior may sign cooperative agreements with public or private groups for educational and interpretive work at the site.
when_it_takes_effect: Enacted April 4, 2018; the summary does not list a separate effective date.
